entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales', 'Support', or 'Returns' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to a returns specialist now.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, with VeloFit support. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac, I need to start a return for an order I received a few days ago. It's for a pair of road cycling shoes.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have the order number handy?

Thank you. I see the order right here, delivered on January 8th. To make sure I understand the situation correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the cycling shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a sizing or preference issue?
It's a sizing issue. I took them for one short ride after installing my cleats, and they just don't fit my foot shape correctly. I'm already getting blisters on my heel.

I'm sorry to hear they weren't a comfortable fit. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our riders. Since you received them just four days ago, you're well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process a full refund for you.

Okay, a full refund sounds good. I appreciate that. Now, since I am a VIP member and have to go through the hassle of uninstalling the cleats, packing this all up, and driving to the post office, is there any chance you could offer a small discount code for my next purchase? I'm planning to order a different pair from your website today.
That's a reasonable request, and I certainly appreciate your loyalty as a VIP member. I absolutely understand the inconvenience. Let me check what I'm authorized to do here. One moment.

Okay, thank you for waiting. As a thank you for your business and to help with your next purchase, I can add a 15% discount code directly to your account. It will be ready to use immediately. How does that sound?
That's perfect, Isaac. A 15% discount is very helpful. I'll accept that. Thank you for working with me.

You're very welcome. I've just applied that discount to your account. I'm also sending the prepaid return label to your email now. Once we receive the shoes back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed. Will there be anything else for you today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
